architecture: Unchanged channel-local 24-unit SiLU plus learned linear skip, full physical gate inputs in log space. Fit initialization estimates local skip and bias by least squares using fit-only exact labels and zeros nonlinear output weights. No analytic exponents supplied. All parameters subsequently trainable.
objective: Exact raw-log MSE/900 + absolute opening MSE. Shared minibatches, paired starting random matrices, independent Adam moments and gradient clipping. Decay factor 1 to 0.01 geometrically over 15000 updates; constant stays 1.
selection: Common development exact-log MSE/900 + absoluteMSE, earliest tie including update0. Freeze before fresh. Report initialization, final and selected checkpoints separately so fit-only success cannot be attributed to Adam.

hypotheses.claim: Persistent step size prevents convergence to the known achievable static map.
hypotheses.contrast: Decay versus constant within each initialization, same data and budget.

hypotheses.claim: Distance or conditioning at initialization dominates the optimization gap.
hypotheses.contrast: Fit-estimated versus standard initialization under each schedule; inspect update0 and any subsequent degradation.

hypotheses.claim: The standard initialization mainly needs additional training budget.
hypotheses.contrast: Nested checkpoints5000,10000,15000 on the same trajectory; no reruns or fresh selection.

cost.scope: Packed12 same-architecture models; diagnostic only, not matched deployment speedup.

limitations: Static full physical state readout only. Fit-initialized solution is data-derived linear regression plus unchanged trainable nonlinear architecture, not proof of SGD discovery or recurrent compression. Sampled current thresholds unchanged; no temporal or closed-loop qualification.
